```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidypopgen)
library(ggplot2)
library(resrepo)
```

```{r set-directories}
res_dir <- path_resrepo("results/s03_malagasy_pca/")
```

# Load gt

```{r}
malagasy_merged <- gt_load(path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/malagasy_merge_master_v2.gt"))
```

# Impute

```{r}
malagasy_merged <- gt_impute_simple(malagasy_merged, method = "random")
```

# PCA

```{r}
random_pca <- gt_pca_randomSVD(malagasy_merged)
pcs <- as.data.frame(random_pca$u)
variance <- round((random_pca$d^2/sum(random_pca$d^2))*100,1)
```

# Plot

```{r}
ggplot(pcs, aes(x = V1, y = V2, group = malagasy_merged$population, colour = malagasy_merged$population, shape = malagasy_merged$population, fill = malagasy_merged$population)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1,3,7,15,17,19,21,23))+
  labs(title = NULL, x = paste0("PC 1 (",variance[1],"%)"), y = paste0("PC 2 (",variance[2],"%)"), colour = "Population", shape = "Population", fill = "Population") +
  theme(legend.position = "right")+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2")

ggsave(paste0(res_dir, "madagascar_pca.jpg"), width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```


This PCA uses the KING relatedness filtering of 0.177, equivalent to a first degree relatives (parent, sibling, or child).

There is justification for keeping second degree close relatives (aunts, uncles, grandparents, grandchildren, nieces, nephews, and half-siblings) because the prevalence of consanguinity in each population is unknown, but likely to be high in places, and therefore removing all second degree relatives substantially reduces the sample size.

To explore how relatedness might be affecting the PCA, the next dataset will show a more stringent relatedness threshold of 0.0442, equivalent to second degree relatives.

# Create a dataset with more stringent relatedness

```{r}
madagascar <- gt_load(path_resrepo("data/raw/data_input/Madagascar_full_cleaned.gt"))
madagascar_p <- gt_load(path_resrepo("data/raw/data_input/Pierron_Malagasy_clean.gt"))

madagascar <- madagascar %>% group_by(population)
individual_report_m <- qc_report_indiv(madagascar, kings_threshold = 0.0442)
madagascar_p <- madagascar_p %>% group_by(population)
individual_report_m_p <- qc_report_indiv(madagascar_p, kings_threshold = 0.0442)

#find relatives
madagascar <- madagascar %>% ungroup()
madagascar_p <- madagascar_p %>% ungroup()

madagascar_low_rel <- madagascar %>% filter(id %in% individual_report_m$id & individual_report_m$to_keep == TRUE)
madagascar_p_low_rel<- madagascar_p %>% filter(id %in% individual_report_m_p$id & individual_report_m_p$to_keep == TRUE)


if(file.exists(path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/malagasy_merge_master_low_kin.gt"))){
  file.remove(path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/malagasy_merge_master_low_kin.gt"))
  file.remove(path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/malagasy_merge_master_low_kin.bk"))
  file.remove(path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/malagasy_merge_master_low_kin.rds"))
}

#merge again
malagasy_low_rel <- rbind(madagascar_low_rel,madagascar_p_low_rel,as_is = FALSE, flip_strand = TRUE, quiet = FALSE, backingfile = path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/malagasy_merge_master_low_kin"))

#malagasy_low_rel <- gt_load(path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/malagasy_merge_master_low_kin.gt"))

# impute 
malagasy_low_rel <- gt_impute_simple(malagasy_low_rel, method = "random")

# ld clumping
to_keep_LD <- loci_ld_clump(malagasy_low_rel, thr_r2 = 0.5, size = 50, return_id = TRUE)

#remove out of LD
malagasy_low_rel <- malagasy_low_rel %>% select_loci(all_of(to_keep_LD))
```

# Difference in sample size

```{r}
nrow(malagasy_merged)
nrow(malagasy_low_rel)
```

# PCA 

```{r}
random_pca2 <- gt_pca_randomSVD(malagasy_low_rel)
pcs <- as.data.frame(random_pca2$u)
variance <- round((random_pca2$d^2/sum(random_pca2$d^2))*100,1)
```

# Plot

```{r}
ggplot(pcs, aes(x = V1, y = V2, group = malagasy_low_rel$population, colour = malagasy_low_rel$population, shape = malagasy_low_rel$population, fill = malagasy_low_rel$population)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1,3,7,15,17,19,21,23))+
  labs(title = NULL, x = paste0("PC 1 (",variance[1],"%)") , y =  paste0("PC 2 (",variance[2],"%)"), colour = "Population", shape = "Population", fill = "Population") +
  theme(legend.position = "right")+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2")

ggsave(paste0(res_dir, "madagascar_pca_king_0442.jpg"), width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

Altering the relatedness filtering reduced the sample size from 243 to 189. The PCA plot shows a similar distribution of the Malagasy samples, but with a slightly different spread and slightly reduced explained variance. It therefore appears that the relatedness filtering has a small effect on the PCA, but the overall structure of the Malagasy samples is maintained.

Here, relatedness filtering was applied within populations using %>% group_by(population). Below, the relatedness filtering is applied across all samples.

# Create a dataset with relatedness filtering across all samples

```{r}
madagascar <- gt_load(path_resrepo("data/raw/data_input/Madagascar_full_cleaned.gt"))
madagascar_p <- gt_load(path_resrepo("data/raw/data_input/Pierron_Malagasy_clean.gt"))

individual_report_m <- qc_report_indiv(madagascar, kings_threshold = 0.0442)
individual_report_m_p <- qc_report_indiv(madagascar_p, kings_threshold = 0.0442)

madagascar_low_rel <- madagascar %>% filter(id %in% individual_report_m$id & individual_report_m$to_keep == TRUE)
madagascar_p_low_rel<- madagascar_p %>% filter(id %in% individual_report_m_p$id & individual_report_m_p$to_keep == TRUE)

if(file.exists(path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/malagasy_merge_master_low_kin_original.gt"))){
  file.remove(path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/malagasy_merge_master_low_kin_original.gt"))
  file.remove(path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/malagasy_merge_master_low_kin_original.bk"))
  file.remove(path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/malagasy_merge_master_low_kin_original.rds"))
}

#merge again
malagasy_low_rel_original <- rbind(madagascar_low_rel,madagascar_p_low_rel,as_is = FALSE, flip_strand = TRUE, quiet = FALSE, backingfile = path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/malagasy_merge_master_low_kin_original"))

#malagasy_low_rel <- gt_load(path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/malagasy_merge_master_low_kin_original.gt"))

# impute 
malagasy_low_rel_original <- gt_impute_simple(malagasy_low_rel_original, method = "random")

# ld clumping
to_keep_LD <- loci_ld_clump(malagasy_low_rel_original, thr_r2 = 0.5, size = 50, return_id = TRUE)

#remove out of LD
malagasy_low_rel_original <- malagasy_low_rel_original %>% select_loci(all_of(to_keep_LD))

```

# Difference in sample size

```{r}
nrow(malagasy_low_rel)
nrow(malagasy_low_rel_original)
```

# PCA

```{r}
random_pca3 <- gt_pca_randomSVD(malagasy_low_rel_original)
pcs <- as.data.frame(random_pca3$u)
variance <- round((random_pca3$d^2/sum(random_pca3$d^2))*100,1)
```

# Plot

```{r}
ggplot(pcs, aes(x = V1, y = V2, group = malagasy_low_rel_original$population, colour = malagasy_low_rel_original$population, shape = malagasy_low_rel_original$population, fill = malagasy_low_rel_original$population)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1,3,7,15,17,19,21,23))+
  labs(title = NULL, x = paste0("PC 1 (",variance[1],"%)") , y =  paste0("PC 2 (",variance[2],"%)"), colour = "Population", shape = "Population", fill = "Population") +
  theme(legend.position = "right")+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2")

ggsave(paste0(res_dir, "madagascar_pca_king_0442_ungrouped_filtering.jpg"), width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

Altering the relatedness filtering reduced the sample size from 189 to 181. Removing these 8 individuals has a signficant affect on the PCA structure. The samples are now more dispersed, with a reduced explained variance for both PC's.
